heading.en: When only the ratio y/x matters

hook.en: Zoom a photo in or out and the shapes stay the same. Some *differential equations* behave like that: scale x and y together and nothing changes. A clever substitution turns them into separable ones.
hook.kn: ಫೋಟೋವನ್ನು ದೊಡ್ಡದು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿಕ್ಕದು ಮಾಡಿದರೂ ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಕೆಲವು ಅವಕಲನ ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳೂ ಹಾಗೆಯೇ: x ಮತ್ತು y ಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಮಾಪಿಸಿದರೆ ಏನೂ ಬದಲಾಗದು. ಜಾಣ ಆದೇಶದಿಂದ ಅವನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸಮೀಕರಣಗಳಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

title.en: Test whether a function is homogeneous and find its degree
Solve it with the substitution y = vx

say.en: Zoom a photo in or out and the shapes stay the same. Some differential equations behave like that: scale x and y together and nothing changes. A clever substitution turns them into separable ones. In this lesson: Test whether a function is homogeneous and find its degree.
Recognise a homogeneous differential equation.
Solve it with the substitution y equals vx.

body.en: $F(x, y)$ is *homogeneous* of degree $n$ if $F(\lambda x, \lambda y) = \lambda^n F(x, y)$. The equation $\frac{dy}{dx} = F(x, y)$ is homogeneous if $F$ is homogeneous of degree zero; then $F$ can be written as $g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$.
body.kn: F(λx, λy) = λⁿF(x, y) ಆದರೆ F ಯು n ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪ ಫಲನ. dy/dx = F(x, y) ಯಲ್ಲಿ F ಶೂನ್ಯ ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪವಾದರೆ ಸಮೀಕರಣ ಏಕರೂಪ; ಆಗ F = g(y/x).

points.en: Test: replace x → λx, y → λy
Degree zero ⇔ depends only on y/x

narration.en: Replace x by lambda x and y by lambda y. If lambda to the power n comes out, the function is homogeneous of degree n. The equation d y by d x equals F is homogeneous when F has degree zero, that is, F depends only on y by x.
narration.kn: F(λx, λy) = λⁿF(x, y) ಆದರೆ F ಯು n ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪ ಫಲನ. dy/dx = F(x, y) ಯಲ್ಲಿ F ಶೂನ್ಯ ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪವಾದರೆ ಸಮೀಕರಣ ಏಕರೂಪ; ಆಗ F = g(y/x).

say.en: Replace x by lambda x and y by lambda y. If lambda to the power n comes out, the function is homogeneous of degree n. The equation d y by d x equals F is homogeneous when F has degree zero, that is, F depends only on y by x. Test: replace x gives lambda x, y gives lambda y.
say.kn: F(lambda x, lambda y) equals lambda to the power nF(x, y) ಆದರೆ F ಯು n ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪ ಫಲನ. dy over dx equals F(x, y) ಯಲ್ಲಿ F ಶೂನ್ಯ ಘಾತದ ಏಕರೂಪವಾದರೆ ಸಮೀಕರಣ ಏಕರೂಪ; ಆಗ F equals g(y over x).

say.en: Degree zero if and only if depends only on y over x.

narration.en: The teacher tests for homogeneity, substitutes y = vx, separates the variables and returns to y.

say.en: d y by d x = x plus y over x. Replace x and y by lambda x and lambda y: lambda cancels, so the function is homogeneous of degree 0.
Put y = v x. Then d y by d x becomes v plus x d v by d x.
Substitute: v plus x d v by d x = 1 plus v. The v cancels and the variables separate.
Integrate: v = log x plus C. Put v = y by x back: y = x log x plus C x.
Here are three members of this family, for C = minus 1, 0 and 1.

narration.en: In a homogeneous equation dy/dx = g(y/x), the slope depends only on v = y/x. Every point on a ray from the origin has the same v, so the same slope. Drag P and stretch it to λP.
narration.kn: ಸಮಘಾತೀಯ ಸಮೀಕರಣ dy/dx = g(y/x) ಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಳಿಜಾರು v = y/x ಮೇಲೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಅವಲಂಬಿತ. ಮೂಲಬಿಂದುವಿನಿಂದ ಹೊರಡುವ ಕಿರಣದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಿಂದುವಿಗೂ ಒಂದೇ v, ಒಂದೇ ಇಳಿಜಾರು. P ಎಳೆದು λP ಗೆ ಹಿಗ್ಗಿಸಿ.

tryThis.en: Change λ. Do the yellow and green slope marks stay parallel?
Look along the x-axis (v = 0) in the field. Is every mark the same?
This is why the substitution y = vx works: what does it turn the equation into?

say.en: In a homogeneous equation dy over dx equals g(y over x), the slope depends only on v equals y over x. Every point on a ray from the origin has the same v, so the same slope. Drag P and stretch it to lambda P.

body.en: Put $y = vx$, so $\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}$. The equation becomes $v + x\frac{dv}{dx} = g(v)$, i.e. $\frac{dv}{g(v) - v} = \frac{dx}{x}$, which is separable. Integrate, then replace $v$ by $\frac{y}{x}$.
body.kn: y = vx ಆದೇಶಿಸಿ; dy/dx = v + x dv/dx. ಸಮೀಕರಣ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಬಹುದಾದದ್ದಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅನುಕಲಿಸಿ, ಕೊನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ v ಬದಲಿಗೆ y/x ಹಾಕಿ.

points.en: Do not forget the extra x dv/dx term
Replace v by y/x in the final answer

steps.en: F(x, y) = (x + y)/x = 1 + y/x is homogeneous of degree 0. Put y = vx.
v + x dv/dx = 1 + v, so x dv/dx = 1, i.e. dv = dx/x.
v = log|x| + C. Replace v = y/x: y = x log|x| + Cx.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Solve dy/dx = (x + y)/x.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Solve dy over dx equals x plus y/x.
F(x, y) equals x plus y/x equals 1 plus y over x is homogeneous of degree 0. Put y equals vx.
v plus x dv over dx equals 1 plus v, so x dv over dx equals 1, i.e. dv equals dx over x.
v equals log|x| plus C. Replace v equals y over x: y equals x log|x| plus Cx.
So the answer is y equals x log|x| plus Cx.

body.en: If the equation can be written as dy/dx = g(y/x), put y = vx. If it is easier as dx/dy = h(x/y), put x = vy and dx/dy = v + y dv/dy. Pick the one that matches the variable on top of the derivative.

narration.en: Which substitution?. If the equation can be written as dy/dx = g(y/x), put y = vx. If it is easier as dx/dy = h(x/y), put x = vy and dx/dy = v + y dv/dy. Pick the one that matches the variable on top of the derivative.

mnemonic.en: y on top → y = vx; x on top → x = vy

say.en: Which substitution?. If the equation can be written as dy over dx equals g(y over x), put y equals vx. If it is easier as dx over dy equals h(x over y), put x equals vy and dx over dy equals v plus y dv over dy. Pick the one that matches the variable on top of the derivative.
